comment: Linken's Process page config and its maps file, from Git Crafter v7.0.0 templates/process/config.json. No deploy map, and Contribute drops its deploy step: Linken ships no deployment. Triage drops its card step: Linken has no project board, so projects.latest_cycle_hours is not on its Quality page. Guard and Decide come from the Claudius pack that quality/config.json names. Keys: Git Crafter actions/pages/action.yml; maps: pages/maps/README.md.

maps.name: Clean-up
maps.why: Keep who matters, remove clear spam, prove every removal

steps.name: Load
steps.rule: Rate from the member's own export, on their Mac.

steps.name: Level
steps.rule: Core is never queued; time without contact is not a reason.

steps.name: Check live
steps.rule: Nothing goes on the export alone: the page must still show it.

steps.name: Remove
steps.rule: One at a time, paced, stop at any warning.

steps.name: Save
steps.rule: Every removal and skip is saved; a removal is final.

steps.name: Verify
steps.rule: The total drops by exactly the removals.
